blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: I'll sleep on the couch. You can have my bed.
exercises.ru: Я посплю на диване, ___ ты можешь расположиться на моей кровати.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Let's eat first and then think about it.
exercises.ru: Давайте сначала покушаем, ___ потом подумаем.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Close the windows. Otherwise, mosquitoes will get in.
exercises.ru: Закройте окна, ___ комары налетят.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: It's not a lie. It's an alternative truth.
exercises.ru: Это не ложь, ___ альтернативная правда.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: We'll first go to Osijek and then we'll visit Vukovar.
exercises.ru: Сначала мы поедем в Осиек, ___ потом посетим Вуковар.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This is a copy, not the original.
exercises.ru: Это копия, ___ не подлинник.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: They are not giants but trolls.
exercises.ru: Они не гиганты, ___ тролли.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: That is not a horse, but a donkey.
exercises.ru: Это не лошадь, ___ осёл.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: In case the alarm rings, walk, don't run.
exercises.ru: Если зазвучит тревога - иди, ___ не беги.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom's palms were sweaty and his mouth was dry.
exercises.ru: Ладони Тома были потные, ___ во рту пересохло.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The pain subsided, but the mobility of the arm returned very slowly.
exercises.ru: Боль отступила, ___ подвижность руки восстанавливалась очень медленно.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom was previously a drunk, but now he's a teetotaler.
exercises.ru: Раньше Том был забулдыгой, ___ теперь - трезвенник.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: If there's a dowry, even a goat will serve as a bride.
exercises.ru: Было бы приданое, ___ в невесты и козлиха сгодится.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: They're trying to preserve the status quo, not to improve anything.
exercises.ru: Они пытаются сохранить статус кво, ___ не что-то улучшить.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: She isn't paid monthly, but daily.
exercises.ru: Ей платят не помесячно, ___ подневно.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The ideal lexicographer knows simply everything; unfortunately, that's impossible.
exercises.ru: Идеальный лексикограф знает просто всё, ___ это, к сожалению, невозможно.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This is not peace; it's an armistice for twenty years.
exercises.ru: Это не мир, ___ перемирие на двадцать лет.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He can't read French, much less write it.
exercises.ru: Он и читать-то по-французски не умеет, ___ уж писать тем более.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Look before you leap.
exercises.ru: Семь раз отмерь, ___ один отрежь.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I wanted to ask Mary out but I chickened out at the last moment.
exercises.ru: Я хотел пригласить Мэри на свидание, ___ струсил в последний момент.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
